title_en: Re-announcement: Korea Polar Research Institute Trainee Recruitment, Second Half of 2026
summary: The Korea Polar Research Institute has re-announced its trainee recruitment for the second half of 2026, and the period runs until Friday, 4 December, at 18:00. The notice gives no eligibility, document or procedure details; students who are interested should read the full job posting at https://kopri.recruiter.co.kr/career/jobs/135012.

dates.what: Close of the re-announced trainee recruitment (the notice does not say what must be submitted by this time; see the linked job posting)

steps: Open the job posting at https://kopri.recruiter.co.kr/career/jobs/135012 and read the eligibility requirements and application procedure there, because the department notice does not include them.
Complete whatever the job posting requires before Friday, 4 December, 18:00.
translation:
Title: Re-announcement of the Korea Polar Research Institute Trainee Recruitment for the Second Half of 2026 (until Friday, 4 December, 18:00)

Job posting URL: https://kopri.recruiter.co.kr/career/jobs/135012

(Note: The notice consists only of the title and the link above. The content of the linked job posting is not included in the notice and was not read.)
